name: Rocket.Chat
description: Rocket.Chat is a communication platform available as separately administered cloud and self-managed workspaces with rooms, messages, integrations, applications, and APIs.
agentUseSummary: Rocket.Chat cannot currently be connected because a customer administrator registers an OAuth application independently in each workspace and the resulting app has full access to the authorizing user's account without granular read-only scopes. Customer-owned bot/app identities and personal tokens are distinct authority models, so Relay requires an explicit product decision before defining actions.

blocked.label: Connect per-workspace OAuth
blocked.description: Each workspace administrator must register Relay and supply workspace-specific credentials and endpoints, while the token can perform every action available to the authorizing user.

blocked.label: Use a bot or app identity
blocked.description: Customer-owned bot and application identities are separately governed products whose membership, role, installation, update, and revocation contracts are not selected here.

blocked.label: Use a personal access token
blocked.description: A personal token is a long-lived user credential authenticated with the user's ID, not delegated OAuth or narrowly scoped account authority.

blocked.label: Access Rocket.Chat data
blocked.description: Users, rooms, channels, groups, direct messages, posts, threads, files, reactions, moderation, settings, integrations, webhooks, exports, realtime subscriptions, and every read or write remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Use raw Rocket.Chat access
blocked.description: Arbitrary workspace origins, paths, REST or realtime endpoints, raw tools, pagination, and automatic retries are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled until Relay selects one exact workspace-specific user or application identity and accepts its authority.

runtimeSupport.description: No Rocket.Chat identity, authority, or wrapper contract is authorized to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No Rocket.Chat identity, authority, or wrapper contract is authorized to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Rocket.Chat OAuth is registered per workspace and gives the application full effective authority over the authorizing user's account; bot/app identities and personal tokens are different customer-owned credential products.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request workspace credentials or show Connect. Reconsider after an explicit product/security decision selects per-workspace OAuth, a least-privilege bot/app identity, or another narrowly governed model and accepts its exact authority.

evidence.supports: Rocket.Chat documents an administrator creating the third-party application inside each workspace and copying that workspace's client ID, secret, authorization URL, and access-token URL.
Rocket.Chat explicitly warns that OAuth apps have full account access and can perform any action on behalf of the authorizing user.
Authenticated API requests use Rocket.Chat workspace session identity rather than a universal provider-owned Relay account boundary.
Personal access tokens are irrecoverable user credentials used with X-Auth-Token and X-User-Id and are not delegated OAuth grants.
